svg.title: Сгибание рук с канатом сидя — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. SEATED LOW-CABLE ROPE BICEPS CURL. Draw the same person sitting upright on a low flat bench and facing a compact cable station in each half; feet flat and elbows fixed at sides. Cable comes visibly from ankle-level low pulley in front and attaches to midpoint of short split gym rope. Two hands grip one rope end each, palms face each other. LEFT hands low in front of knees, elbows extended. RIGHT hands rise toward shoulders after elbow flexion, seated trunk stays upright. Clearly separate rope handle ends, taut cable, pulley and bench. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
